outcome.rngambling.meteor_strike.desc: An ender dragon growl, then a flame-and-smoke trail descends over 2 seconds onto a random ground spot within 8 blocks of the player (x/z). It lands as a power 6 explosion with fire (capped by the max_explosion_power config, default 6).
outcome.rngambling.tnt_monsoon.desc: 20-40 primed TNT fall from 20 blocks above the lucky block, each at a random spot within 12 blocks (x/z), spread evenly over about 10 seconds. Each has a 3-4 second fuse and explodes as normal TNT (power 4).
outcome.rngambling.charged_creeper_squad: 3 creepers spawn in a ring 4.5 blocks around the player and are charged by visual-only lightning (it does no damage or fire, and they start at full health, not burning). Charged creepers blow up at power 6.
outcome.rngambling.cursed_armor_swap.des: All four armour slots get plain leather pieces with Curse of Binding I. Whatever armour was worn is dropped at the player's feet, not deleted.
outcome.rngambling.total_xp_drain.desc: Experience is set to level 0, with 0 points, and portal particles play around the player. Nothing is refunded.
outcome.rngambling.inventory_explosion.d: Every inventory slot (hotbar, main inventory, armour and off hand) is emptied, and the items are flung out in all directions from the player. They can't be picked up for 1 second and last 10 minutes on the ground instead of 5.
outcome.rngambling.orbital_launch.desc: The player is shot straight up at 7 blocks per tick, which carries them about 150 blocks up in roughly 2.5 seconds. They then fall back down: lethal fall damage unless they have something to save them (water, elytra, slow falling, etc.).
outcome.rngambling.thunder_gods_wrath.de: 10 real lightning bolts (they do damage and set fire) strike the player's position, one every 2 seconds for 20 seconds, the first after 2 seconds. The strikes stop if the player dies, logs off or changes dimension.
outcome.rngambling.the_crater.desc: A sphere of radius 7, centred 6 blocks below the player's feet, is deleted (no drops) with an explosion sound, so the hole reaches 13 blocks down. Only natural ground is removed: stone/deepslate-type, dirt, sand, gravel, netherrack-type, end stone, terracotta, clay and sandstone, and never blocks with block entities. Ores, logs and anything built stay put.
outcome.rngambling.raid_omen.desc: The player gets Bad Omen V for 100 minutes (entering a village with it starts a raid), and 3 pillagers spawn in a ring 10 blocks around them.
outcome.rngambling.the_last_gamble.desc: Health is set to 1 HP (half a heart), and a title says "Half a heart. Survive 60 seconds...". If the player is still alive and in the same dimension after 60 seconds, chat says "You survived The Last Gamble! A Legendary reward:" and a random Legendary-tier effect plays at luck 100 (it gets its own announcement). Note: the quip says "One heart", but it is half a heart.
outcome.rngambling.cursed_mining.desc: For 5 minutes, each block the player breaks has a 25% chance to do something: half of those spawn a silverfish at the block, the other half are a power 1.5 explosion there (not capped by config). The curse is kept in memory, so a server restart ends it early.
outcome.rngambling.herd_of_ravagers.desc: 3 ravagers spawn in a ring 9 blocks around the player, each ridden by an Evoker, and all are set to target the player.
outcome.rngambling.doomsday_clock.desc: A red, notched boss bar "Doomsday Clock: RUN!" empties over 10 seconds, with a ticking hat sound at the lucky block each second (higher pitched for the last 4). At 10 seconds the block's spot explodes at power 7 with fire, but the max_explosion_power cap (default 6) means it is actually power 6 by default.
outcome.rngambling.wither_arena.desc: The player is put in a sealed 29x29 obsidian box (11 blocks tall inside, lit with glowstone), and a Wither is spawned there in its charging-up start (about 11 seconds invulnerable, as if built by hand). The room has no exit: it ends as soon as nothing hostile is left (once the Wither and its skulls are gone, after at least 5 seconds). Otherwise it ends after 5 minutes. Drops such as the Nether Star come home with the player, and room blocks can't be broken.
outcome.rngambling.wardens_hollow.desc: An 80-block deepslate/sculk tunnel (7 wide, 6 tall) with the exit at the far end, played under Darkness for up to 5 minutes. The player's Warden warning level starts at 2 or more, so two more shrieks summon a Warden. A summoning-capable shrieker sits every 8 blocks on alternating walls. Sculk sensors along the edges hear non-sneaking movement, and bone-block floor tiles (which rattle) and blackstone pressure plates each set off the nearest shrieker when stepped on, even when sneaking. Chat: "Reach the far end. Sneak past the sensors, and watch your step: bones rattle and plates click." Darkness is removed when it ends.
outcome.rngambling.void_platform.desc: The player stands on a 9x9 stone platform 100 blocks up and gets 8 Sandbox-only cobblestone (placing is allowed here). Chat: "The platform will crumble! Hold on for 30 seconds...". After a 3-2-1 title countdown ("CRUMBLE!"), a block darkens every 0.3 seconds and falls 0.6 seconds later, with every 4th one being the block under the player; the platform is gone in about 25 seconds. After 30 seconds of crumbling, a stone block with an exit on it appears 2 blocks from the player ("A way out has opened!"). Dropping 8 blocks below the platform fails the room ("You fell! Back you go, with nothing."), and it times out after 100 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.rising_lava_tomb.desc: A sealed stone-brick box, 5x5 inside. Its two lowest wall rows have a few cracked-brick decoys and one real weak pair at floor level, two high, made of infested cracked bricks (so breaking them may release silverfish). These are the only breakable blocks, and they lead to a 4-block tunnel with the exit. A red boss bar counts "Lava in N seconds" from 15, with big title numbers for the last 5. Then lava fills the floor area one layer every 5 seconds, 8 layers in all. It times out after 85 seconds. Messages: the rules, the title "The lava is coming!" / "Find the cracked brick that breaks", and "The lava is rising!".
outcome.rngambling.elder_guardian_monume: A fully flooded prismarine-brick chamber (15x15, 9 deep inside) with 2 Elder Guardians, which give their usual Mining Fatigue. The player starts underwater at one end, and the exit is against the far wall, about 13 blocks away. It has no water breathing, a 3-minute limit, and Mining Fatigue is removed when it ends.
outcome.rngambling.nether_fortress_ambus: A 5-wide, 41-long nether-brick corridor lit by shroomlights, with 4 blazes and 4 wither skeletons spaced along it. The exit is at the far end, and there is a 3-minute limit.
outcome.rngambling.empowered_wither.desc: A ruined ring of stone bricks (radius 15, 2-6 high, no roof) with a Wither that has double max health (600) and +6 armour, starting in its charging-up phase and at its full 600 health when the fight begins. Every 20 seconds while it lives, 2 wither skeletons spawn beside it. When it dies, an End City treasure chest and a Bastion treasure chest appear at the centre ("The Empowered Wither falls! Its treasure is yours: 30 seconds to loot."), and the player is brought back 30 seconds later with what they carry or dropped. Otherwise it ends after 6 minutes, and it has no exit portal.
outcome.rngambling.anvil_rain.desc: In the Sandbox, 26 anvils drop one every 0.3 seconds (about 8 seconds in all) from 12 blocks above random spots within 3 blocks of the player. Each does 2 damage per block fallen, up to 40. The visit lasts at least 10 seconds and ends once things settle (90 seconds at most).
outcome.rngambling.zombie_horde.desc: 8-12 zombies spawn in a ring 6 blocks around the player: 8 + 4 x strength, so 12 at luck -100 and about 10 at -45. Each has a 60% chance of a helmet (leather, iron or chainmail) and a 40% chance of a chestplate (leather or iron).
outcome.rngambling.skeleton_snipers.desc: 4 ordinary skeletons spawn in a ring 9 blocks around the player.
outcome.rngambling.fused_creeper.desc: A creeper spawns 2 blocks behind the player (opposite where they look), already ignited, and explodes after the normal 1.5-second fuse (power 3).
outcome.rngambling.block_detonation.desc: A power 3 explosion, without fire, goes off right where the lucky block was.
outcome.rngambling.obsidian_cage.desc: In the Sandbox, the player is sealed in an obsidian box (3x3 inside, 3 tall, with floor and roof), with a creeper spawned right beside them. The obsidian is removed after 30 seconds. The visit lasts at least 31 seconds and ends once nothing is left alive (90 seconds at most).
outcome.rngambling.spider_web_trap.desc: In the Sandbox, each empty block in a 7x7, 3-tall area around the player has a 45% chance of becoming a cobweb. 3 cave spiders drop in from 4 blocks up, in a ring 2 blocks out. The webs are cleared after 45 seconds, and the visit lasts at least 15 seconds, ending once the spiders are dead (90 seconds at most).
outcome.rngambling.silverfish_infestatio: In the Sandbox, 8 pillars of infested stone (3 high) rise in a ring 4 blocks around the player, and 6 silverfish spawn within 3 blocks of the block spot. Breaking the pillars releases more. The visit lasts at least 10 seconds and ends once all are dead (90 seconds at most).
outcome.rngambling.lava_shower.desc: In the Sandbox, a lava source block is placed 4 blocks above the player's feet (only if that spot is empty) and flows down over them. The source is removed after 15 seconds, and the visit lasts at least 17 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.witch_coven.desc: 3 witches spawn in a ring 5 blocks around the player, with a witch cackle sound.
outcome.rngambling.phantom_squadron.desc: 6 phantoms spawn 14 blocks up, in a ring 6 blocks around the player, targeting them. They have permanent Fire Resistance, so they don't burn in daylight. Any still alive vanish after 90 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.durability_shatter.de: The item in the main hand, if it has durability, loses half of its remaining durability. It is never broken outright and always keeps at least 1 use. Nothing happens if the hand is empty or holds an item without durability.
outcome.rngambling.hunger_collapse.desc: Food is set to 1 (half a drumstick) and saturation to 0, and the player gets Hunger III for 60 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.poison_cloud.desc: A lingering cloud of radius 4 appears at the lucky block for 10 seconds. It gives Poison II (10 seconds) to anything standing in it, after the cloud's usual 1-second warm-up.
outcome.rngambling.blind_hedge_maze.desc: A freshly generated 8x8-cell hedge maze (24x24 blocks of oak leaves, 3 high, unbreakable) with 4 zombies inside. The player starts in one corner with Blindness for 4 minutes, and the exit is in the opposite corner. It times out after 4 minutes, and Blindness is removed when it ends.
outcome.rngambling.mob_arena_waves.desc: A walled 23x23 stone-brick arena with 3 waves of ordinary (unbuffed) mobs, spawned 9 blocks out and targeting the player. Wave 1 is 4 zombies and 2 skeletons. Wave 2 is 2 zombies, 2 skeletons, 2 spiders and a creeper. The final wave is 2 vindicators, 2 witches, a husk and 2 strays. Each wave comes 3 seconds after the last is cleared (chat: "Wave 1!", "Wave 2!", "Final wave!"). Clearing wave 3 drops 12 iron ingots, 8 emeralds and 2 golden apples ("You survived! Grab your reward."), and the player is brought back 10 seconds later. The time limit is 5 minutes, and there is no exit portal.
outcome.rngambling.skyblock_strand.desc: The player is on a 3x3 grass island 90 blocks up with 24 Sandbox-only cobblestone. A second 3x3 island with the exit is 16 blocks of open air away. Chat: "Bridge to the far island with the cobblestone you've been given (only for here)." Falling 10 blocks below the island fails ("You fell!..."), and there is a 3-minute limit.
outcome.rngambling.drowned_pit.desc: The player starts at the bottom of a 9x9 mossy-cobblestone shaft flooded 19 blocks deep, with 4 trident-wielding Drowned. The exit stands on a ledge at the water's surface in one corner. The limit is 2 minutes, and there is no water breathing.
outcome.rngambling.ravager_charge.desc: One ravager spawns 12 blocks from the player at their height, ridden by a pillager, and is set to target the player.
outcome.rngambling.ghast_bombardment.des: A ghast spawns 16 blocks above the player and targets them (fireballs, which can be hit back). It works in the Overworld too.
outcome.rngambling.fools_diamonds.desc: 6-10 diamonds drop at the lucky block, but they are fakes. When a player tries to pick the stack up, it vanishes and one silverfish spawns per diamond in the stack.
outcome.rngambling.inventory_shuffle.des: The 36 hotbar and main-inventory slots, empty ones included, are randomly shuffled. Armour and the off hand are untouched, and nothing is lost.
outcome.rngambling.slime_split.desc: One big slime (size 4, the largest natural size) spawns within 3 blocks of the lucky block. It splits into medium slimes and then small ones as usual.
outcome.rngambling.ender_swarm.desc: 5 endermen spawn in a ring 5 blocks around the player, already set to target them (angry without being looked at).
outcome.rngambling.gravity_well.desc: The player gets Levitation II for 10 seconds, rising about 19 blocks. When it ends, any Slow Falling they have is stripped and they get Slowness II for 10 seconds, so they drop and take the fall damage. Nothing is actually pulled in, despite the quip.
outcome.rngambling.mob_magnet.desc: For 3 minutes, every 2 seconds, every hostile mob within 48 blocks of the player is set to target them. It spawns no mobs itself and stops if the player dies or changes dimension.
outcome.rngambling.exploding_chickens.de: 5 chickens spawn within 3 blocks of the lucky block. After 3 seconds, each one still alive vanishes in a power 1.5 explosion, without fire.
outcome.rngambling.hot_potato.desc: A lit Hot Potato goes into the player's inventory (dropped at them if full), with the chat warning "A Hot Potato! It goes off in 5 seconds, wherever it is. Throw it!". Each second it fizzes and shows "Hot Potato: N!" over the hotbar. After 5 seconds it explodes at power 3 (no fire) at whoever carries it, or where it lies (smoking) if thrown.
outcome.rngambling.wear_and_tear.desc: One random item with durability anywhere in the inventory (armour and off hand included) that has more than 1 use left drops to its last use, with a break sound and "Your <item> is worn down to its last use.". If nothing can wear: health goes to 1 HP, food to 1 with 0 saturation, and Hunger I for 60 seconds ("Nothing you carry could wear, so you did. Eat before your last hunger runs out, or die!"). Then, for 5 minutes, if food hits 0 with no food item in the inventory, the player dies of starvation. Getting food back to 2 or more ends the threat.
outcome.rngambling.fake_explosion.desc: A TNT-fuse hiss plays where the block was, then 2 seconds later a loud explosion sound with an explosion flash and 40 smoke puffs. No damage and no blocks broken. The chat line and the tier sound come 3 seconds after the break.
outcome.rngambling.fake_death_message.de: Right away you get a chat line in plain text, "<your name> was slain by a Lucky Block". Nothing else happens. Only you see it, and the real announcement follows 3 seconds later.
3 chickens spawn evenly spaced on a ring 4 blocks around you, each ridden by a baby zombie (a chicken jockey). The zombies are normal hostile baby zombies and may get vanilla's random spawn gear.
outcome.rngambling.angry_bees.desc: 4 bees spawn within 2 blocks of where the block was, targeting you and angry for 20 seconds. Each one stings once with vanilla bee poison and then dies.
outcome.rngambling.sand_drop.desc: Falling blocks drop from directly above your head: gravel 3 blocks up, sand 4 up, gravel 5 up and sand 6 up. Each one only spawns if its spot is empty, so there are at most 4. They land on you and stay as real blocks, and if you don't move you can suffocate.
outcome.rngambling.sluggish_brew.desc: You get Slowness II and Mining Fatigue II for 60 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.nausea_spin.desc: You get Nausea I and Weakness I for 30 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.random_teleport.desc: Teleports you to the top surface at a random spot up to 50 blocks away in X and Z (a square, not a circle). The spot must be solid ground that isn't fluid, air or magma, with two empty blocks above it. It makes up to 24 attempts, and if none works you stay put. The surface is the highest solid block, so you can land on logs or a roof.
outcome.rngambling.trapdoor_drop.desc: A 2x2 shaft opens under your feet, covering the 2x2 of blocks nearest where you stand, so you fall in. Each column is dug up to 10 blocks deep and stops at the first block that isn't natural ground (stone and other base stone, dirt, sand, gravel, netherrack-type, end stone, terracotta, clay, sandstone, nothing with a block entity). Player-built blocks, ores, fluids and air stop it. The dug blocks are deleted, not dropped.
outcome.rngambling.silent_creeper.desc: A creeper spawns 5 blocks from you in a random direction, with Invisibility for 120 seconds. For those 120 seconds, whenever it starts to swell it gets Glowing for 3 seconds as a fair warning. Its explosion is a normal creeper's. The chat line only arrives 15 seconds after the break.
outcome.rngambling.yeet_held_item.desc: Your main-hand item (the whole stack) is thrown from eye height in the direction you're looking, at speed 1.4 horizontally and 0.5 upward. It can be picked up after 1.5 seconds and has an extended lifetime, so it won't despawn for about 10 minutes. It is never deleted. With an empty hand nothing happens.
outcome.rngambling.pumpkin_head.desc: Any helmet you're wearing is dropped at your feet (not deleted). A carved pumpkin with Curse of Binding goes on your head, which brings the pumpkin overlay. After 60 seconds the pumpkin is deleted, as long as that same pumpkin is still on your head. Itchy Armor never removes it.
outcome.rngambling.rotten_feast.desc: Drops 16-32 rotten flesh and 4-8 poisonous potatoes where the block was.
outcome.rngambling.vex_swarm.desc: 4 vexes spawn within 1 block of where the block was, targeting you. Vanilla gives them iron swords. They have a 30-second life: after that they take 1 damage per second until they die.
outcome.rngambling.endermite_burst.desc: 4-6 endermites spawn within 2 blocks of where the block was.
outcome.rngambling.cave_spider_pack.desc: 5 cave spiders spawn evenly spaced on a ring 4 blocks around you.
outcome.rngambling.nightfall.desc: Runs /time set night, which sets the time to 13000 (nightfall) for the whole server. It only comes up in singleplayer unless the config allows global effects in multiplayer.
outcome.rngambling.single_lightning_bolt: One real lightning bolt strikes your position. It does vanilla lightning damage, sets you on fire and can light fire around you.
outcome.rngambling.ring_of_fire.desc: Fire is lit on the 16 border spots of a 5x5 square at your feet level, centred on you. It is only placed in empty spots where fire can sit, so the inner 3x3 stays clear. It is ordinary fire and can spread to flammable blocks.
outcome.rngambling.melting_ice_prison.de: Ice fills the empty spaces of a 3x3 hollow box around you: walls 2 high, a ceiling above your head and a floor under your feet, leaving you a 1x1x2 cell. Only empty spots get ice, so no blocks are replaced. After 15 seconds every block that is still ice is removed. Ice you break yourself may turn to water.
outcome.rngambling.butterfingers.desc: Every 2 seconds for 60 seconds (30 checks, the first 2 seconds in), there is a 35% chance that your main-hand stack is dropped and scattered in a random direction. Items are dropped, never deleted. Empty hands are skipped.
outcome.rngambling.itchy_armor.desc: Every 3 seconds for 60 seconds (20 checks), one random armour slot is picked, and if something is worn there it has a 35% chance of being moved into your inventory. It only does this when you have a free inventory slot, so armour is never dropped or lost. It skips the Pumpkin Head pumpkin, but it can take off other Curse of Binding gear, such as the Cursed Armor Swap leather.
outcome.rngambling.squid_ink.desc: A burst of 60 squid-ink particles at your eyes, and Blindness I for 5 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.lucky_block_respawn.d: A new lucky block with a fixed luck of -20 appears where the old one was, or at an empty spot up to 2 blocks around and 1 up (12 tries). If no spot is found, nothing appears. It counts one deeper in the chain, and chain effects aren't offered to blocks 2 or more deep.
outcome.rngambling.tax_collector.desc: A quarter (rounded up) of each of your emeralds, emerald blocks, gold nuggets, gold ingots, gold blocks and raw gold is taken from your inventory. An unarmed, harmless Pillager named "Tax Collector" then appears within 2 blocks of you and runs away from you for 60 seconds, after which he vanishes in a puff with the takings. Kill him first and he drops everything he took. Extra red chat line: "The Tax Collector took a quarter of your emeralds and gold. Catch him before he gets away!", or "The Tax Collector found nothing to take, and runs off anyway." If he can't spawn, the items go back. A server restart removes him along with the takings.
outcome.rngambling.nothing_happens.desc: A small poof of 12 particles and a low wool-break sound where the block was. Nothing else.
outcome.rngambling.fortune_cookie.desc: An extra italic chat line with one of 10 fortunes picked at random (outcome.rngambling.fortune_cookie.0-9), mostly game hints such as Safe Lucky Blocks, disguised blocks, charms stacking, Nether and End luck, and token piles.
outcome.rngambling.barnyard.desc: 4-6 animals spawn within 3 blocks of where the block was, each one a random cow, pig, sheep, chicken, rabbit or goat.
outcome.rngambling.rainbow_sheep.desc: One sheep named "jeb_" spawns within 2 blocks of where the block was, so its wool cycles through the rainbow.
outcome.rngambling.firework_show.desc: 6 firework rockets launch from spots up to 3 blocks around where the block was. Each has flight 1-2 and a large-ball or star burst with trail and twinkle, in 2 random colours from red, yellow, green, blue, purple and white. Bursts with explosion effects can do vanilla firework damage if one goes off within a few blocks of you.
outcome.rngambling.random_building_block: Drops 16-64 of one block type picked at random from stone bricks, polished andesite, bricks, quartz block, terracotta, prismarine, smooth sandstone, deepslate tiles, mud bricks, cherry planks and copper block.
outcome.rngambling.position_swap.desc: You swap places with the nearest mob within a 16-block box around you. This can be any mob, including pets, villagers and hostiles. If there is none, nothing happens.
outcome.rngambling.weather_roulette.desc: Runs /weather clear, rain or thunder (1 in 3 each, vanilla's default duration) for the whole server. It only comes up in singleplayer unless the config allows global effects in multiplayer.
outcome.rngambling.pig_rain.desc: 5 pigs spawn 15 blocks above you, each up to 4 blocks off in X and Z. They have Slow Falling for 20 seconds, so they float down and land unhurt.
outcome.rngambling.mystery_potion.desc: You get one effect at level I for 30 seconds, picked at random from 12: Speed, Slowness, Haste, Mining Fatigue, Jump Boost, Nausea, Regeneration, Weakness, Night Vision, Blindness, Strength and Hunger.
outcome.rngambling.size_shift.desc: A 50/50 between half size (scale x0.5) and double size (scale x2) for 60 seconds. Logging out also ends it. A new Size Shift replaces the old one rather than stacking.
outcome.rngambling.coin_flip.desc: A 50/50 title on screen: green "Heads! (luck +30)" or red "Tails! (luck -30)". 1.5 seconds later a fresh random effect (never Coin Flip again) plays at the block's luck plus or minus 30 (kept within -100 to 100), with its own chat announcement.
outcome.rngambling.echo_blocks.desc: Two new lucky blocks appear, one 2 blocks east and one 2 blocks west of where the block was (or at an empty spot up to 2 blocks around and 1 up). Each gets its own random luck from -20 to 20. They count one deeper in the chain, so blocks 2 deep don't offer chain effects.
outcome.rngambling.wandering_trader.desc: 1 wandering trader and 2 trader llamas spawn within 3 blocks of where the block was. The llamas are not leashed to the trader, and the trader despawns on vanilla's timer.
outcome.rngambling.ghast_scream.desc: A loud ghast scream (volume 2) plays at your position. There is no ghast. The announcement comes 2.5 seconds later.
outcome.rngambling.jukebox.desc: A jukebox is placed in a free spot within 2 blocks of where the block was (only into empty space). It starts playing one disc picked at random from cat, blocks, chirp, mall, stal, Pigstep and otherside. After 200 seconds it is removed along with its disc, if it's still there. You can keep the disc by taking it out first, or keep both by mining the jukebox.
outcome.rngambling.time_skip.desc: Runs /time add 6000, which moves the clock forward a quarter day (5 real minutes) for the whole server. It only comes up in singleplayer unless the config allows global effects in multiplayer.
outcome.rngambling.parrot_pal.desc: A parrot of a random colour spawns on you, already tamed to you, and hops onto your shoulder. If both shoulders are taken it stays beside you as a tamed parrot.
outcome.rngambling.snow_golem_escort.des: 2 snow golems spawn on a ring 2 blocks around you and follow you for 5 minutes. Once a second, any golem more than 6 blocks away walks back to you, and any more than 48 blocks away teleports to within 2 blocks of you. After 5 minutes they stay as ordinary snow golems, and they still melt in warm biomes as in vanilla.
outcome.rngambling.disco_floor.desc: The 7x7 floor under you flashes random stained glass in 8 colours, every 0.25 seconds for 15 seconds (60 beats). Each beat plays a bell note at a random pitch, with a bass drum every other beat. Only plain full blocks with air above change: no fluids, block entities, unbreakable blocks or lucky blocks. About 15 seconds in, the floor is put back exactly as it was, even if the server stops first. If no floor qualifies, 4 fireworks go up instead.
outcome.rngambling.llama_spit_party.desc: 4 frozen (no-AI) llamas spawn evenly spaced on a ring 5 blocks around you and turn to face you. Every 0.75 seconds each one has a 60% chance to spit at you, and the spit does no damage. After about 10 seconds (13 volleys) they vanish in a puff. A restart removes them too.
outcome.rngambling.message_in_a_bottle.d: Drops a glass bottle plus a treasure map named "Message in a Bottle", marked with a red X at the nearest unexplored treasure-map structure (buried treasure) within 50 chunks. Where there is none, for example in the Nether or the End, it drops paper instead, with the italic chat line "The message in the bottle is too smudged to read."
outcome.rngambling.mob_shuffle.desc: Up to 24 wild mobs within a 16-block box around you are each replaced, in a poof, by a different random mob from the same group, keeping the same fraction of their health. Hostiles become zombie, skeleton, spider, creeper, husk, stray, cave spider, witch, zombie villager, bogged or slime. Animals become cow, pig, sheep, chicken, rabbit, goat, fox, armadillo or mooshroom. Left alone: named, leashed, riding or ridden mobs, tamed pets and horses, villagers, golems, bosses, wardens, elder guardians, other effects' temporary mobs and non-Animal creatures such as fish. A mirror sound plays.
outcome.rngambling.ghost_block.desc: If the spot is still empty, the lucky block comes back at the same luck (one deeper in the chain) with 3 ghosts, in a puff of soul particles. Each hit makes it vanish and return 1 second later with one ghost fewer. After 3 vanishes it breaks normally and gives a fresh roll.
outcome.rngambling.iron_haul.desc: Drops 16-32 iron ingots where the block was.
outcome.rngambling.gold_haul.desc: Drops 16-32 gold ingots where the block was.
outcome.rngambling.food_basket.desc: Drops 8-16 bread, 8-16 cooked beef (steak), 4-8 golden carrots and 1 cake.
outcome.rngambling.iron_tool_kit.desc: Drops one each of an unenchanted iron sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe.
outcome.rngambling.xp_fountain.desc: Ten bursts of experience orbs worth 16 XP each pop out 1 block above where the block was, one every 4 ticks (about 2 seconds in all): 160 XP total.
outcome.rngambling.potion_pack.desc: Drops three plain (drinkable, not splash) potions: Healing (instant, level I), Swiftness (3:00) and Night Vision (3:00).
outcome.rngambling.wolf_pack.desc: Spawns 3 wolves within 2 blocks of where the block was, already tamed to you.
outcome.rngambling.saddled_horse.desc: Spawns a horse within 3 blocks, tamed to you and saddled, with fixed stats: 26 max health (13 hearts), movement speed 0.28, jump strength 0.8. No armour.
outcome.rngambling.random_enchanted_book: Drops one enchanted book rolled as if at an enchanting table at a random level 15-30 (table enchantments only, so no Mending or other treasure-only ones; may carry more than one enchantment).
outcome.rngambling.speed_demon.desc: Gives you Speed II and Haste II for 3:00 each.
outcome.rngambling.ore_sampler.desc: Drops 8-16 each (rolled separately) of redstone dust, lapis lazuli, coal and copper ingots.
outcome.rngambling.dungeon_chest.desc: Drops one roll of the vanilla dungeon chest loot table (minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon) on the ground, rolled with loot luck = luck / 25 (about 0.6-1.6 in this band).
outcome.rngambling.builders_bundle.desc: Drops 32-64 oak logs, 32-64 stone bricks and 16-32 glass.
outcome.rngambling.bloom_burst.desc: Applies bone meal 24 times to the top surface block at random spots within 6 blocks (x/z) of the block: grass sprouts flowers and tall grass, crops and saplings grow; spots that can't be bone-mealed do nothing. Green 'happy villager' particles.
outcome.rngambling.fortune_pickaxe.desc: Drops an iron pickaxe with Fortune II and Efficiency II.
outcome.rngambling.lucky_rod.desc: Drops a fishing rod with Luck of the Sea III and Lure II.
outcome.rngambling.rancher_kit.desc: Drops 2 name tags, 4 leads and 1 saddle.
outcome.rngambling.farmers_gift.desc: Drops 16 wheat seeds, 8 carrots, 8 potatoes, 8 beetroot seeds and 16 bone meal (fixed counts).
outcome.rngambling.archers_kit.desc: Drops a bow with Power II and 64 arrows.
outcome.rngambling.allay_helper.desc: Spawns one allay 1 block above you, already bonded to you (its liked player), so it brings you items matching whatever you hand it.
outcome.rngambling.healing_rain.desc: Gives you Regeneration II for 20 seconds, sets your hunger to full (20) and saturation to 10, with heart particles over your head. No actual rain.
outcome.rngambling.cat_companion.desc: Spawns 1 cat within 2 blocks, already tamed to you (random coat).
outcome.rngambling.bonus_lucky_blocks.de: Places 2 new lucky blocks, 2 blocks east and 2 blocks west of the broken one (or the nearest empty spot within 2, up to 12 tries; skipped if none), each with its own random luck 20-50. Chain effect: not drawn from a block already 2 deep in a chain.
outcome.rngambling.token_toss.desc: Drops 8-16 Casino Tokens plus round(8 x luck/100) more (+1 at luck 10, +3 at luck 40, +8 at 100), with a chain-clink sound.
outcome.rngambling.casino_invitation.des: Takes you to a 13x11 casino hall in the Sandbox (red concrete floor, yellow trim) with 4 slot machines, a roulette table, a blackjack table, a Higher or Lower table, a Creeper Field and a Casino Dealer villager (level 1); 8 Casino Tokens go into your inventory (yours to keep) and chat says 'Welcome to the casino! 8 tokens on the house. Play as long as you like (up to 10 minutes); leave by the door and your winnings come home with you.' Nothing can be broken or placed; leave through the exit portal just outside the south door whenever you like, or you're sent back after 10 minutes. Everything in your inventory and anything on the floor comes home.
Spawns one player-built iron golem 2.5 blocks from you (it never turns on you). For 10 minutes it follows you: checked every second, it walks to you if more than 8 blocks away and teleports next to you if more than 48 away (same dimension only). After that it stays as an ordinary golem.
outcome.rngambling.ore_vision.desc: Every ore (c:ores tag, any mod) within a 16-block sphere of you gets a glowing outline visible through walls, coloured by ore (diamond cyan, emerald green, gold yellow, iron tan, copper orange, redstone red, lapis blue, coal dark grey, quartz white, ancient debris brown; others white), up to the 300 nearest, for 60 seconds. Chat: 'Ore Vision: N ores glow nearby, for a minute.' (N counts all found, even past 300).
outcome.rngambling.lucky_sense.desc: Every lucky block within 64 blocks in loaded chunks (up to the 100 nearest, disguised ones shown as their disguise) glows through walls for 2 minutes in its luck's colour: green good, white even, red bad. Chat: 'Lucky Sense: N lucky blocks glow nearby, for two minutes. Green is good luck, red is bad.' or, with none, 'Lucky Sense: not a single lucky block within 64 blocks. Unlucky.' Amethyst chime.
outcome.rngambling.mystery_item.desc: Drops one random item from every item that can be crafted (any recipe result), named in a non-block loot table (chests, mobs, fishing, archaeology), or dropped by natural blocks (ores, logs, leaves, flowers, dirt, sand, stone), from vanilla or any mod, minus the #rngambling:lucky_blacklist tag. Stackable items come as 4-16 (capped at their stack size); unstackables as one. A diamond if the list is empty.
outcome.rngambling.diamond_haul.desc: Drops 8 + round(8 x luck/100) diamonds: 11 at luck 41, 14 at 75, 16 at 100 (no randomness).
outcome.rngambling.diamond_armor_set.des: Drops a diamond helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots, each with Protection II.
outcome.rngambling.enchanted_diamond_swo: Drops a diamond sword with Sharpness III and Looting II.
outcome.rngambling.xp_jackpot.desc: Twenty bursts of experience orbs worth 70 XP each, one every 3 ticks (3 seconds in all), 1 block above where the block was: 1,400 XP total.
outcome.rngambling.shulker_loot_box.desc: Drops a purple shulker box holding 4-8 diamonds, 2-4 gold blocks, 2-4 golden apples, 8-16 emeralds, 8-16 bottles o' enchanting, 4-8 ender pearls and one book enchanted as at a level-30 enchanting table.
outcome.rngambling.trident.desc: Drops a trident with Loyalty II.
outcome.rngambling.treasure_vault.desc: Takes you into an 11x11 gold-block vault in the Sandbox with 6 chests along the back wall, filled from vanilla loot tables: dungeon, desert pyramid, bastion treasure, end city treasure, buried treasure and stronghold corridor. A 'Time left' boss bar counts down 40 seconds. Only the chests can be broken (gold walls can't). Leave by the exit portal by the front wall or wait out the timer; either way, what's in your inventory and any items on the floor (e.g. from broken chests) come home.
outcome.rngambling.parkour_course.desc: Puts you on a 3x3 quartz start 60 blocks up in the Sandbox, facing a run of 14 single blocks (quartz, every third gold), each 2-3 blocks further on, up to 1 sideways and sometimes 1 up, ending at a 3x3 platform with an end city treasure chest and the exit portal. Chat: 'Reach the chest at the end. Fall, and you go home with nothing.' Falling 8 blocks below the start fails it ('You fell! Back you go, with nothing.'); 4-minute limit, also a fail. Only the chest can be broken; a fail throws away loose items in the arena and takes back anything you picked up there; what you brought in stays.
outcome.rngambling.puzzle_vault.desc: A quartz room in the Sandbox with 5 levers on the north wall and 5 redstone lamps above them, some already lit (always solvable, never solved at the start). Each lever toggles its lamp and the lamps on either side; chat explains this. Lighting all 5 removes the 2-tall iron door into the back chamber ('The vault door opens!'), which holds an end city treasure chest and the exit portal. Only the chest can be broken; 4-minute limit, after which you're sent back with whatever you hold.
outcome.rngambling.beacon_starter.desc: Drops 9 iron blocks (enough for a 1-level beacon pyramid). No beacon.
outcome.rngambling.mending_book.desc: Drops an enchanted book of Mending.
outcome.rngambling.champions_brew.desc: Gives you Strength II, Regeneration II and Resistance II for 5:00 each.
outcome.rngambling.golden_rain.desc: Every 5 ticks for 10 seconds (40 drops), an item falls from 6 blocks above you, up to 3 blocks off to the side: 30% a gold ingot, otherwise 3 gold nuggets (about 12 ingots and 84 nuggets on average). It follows you as you move, and stops if you die or change dimension.
outcome.rngambling.lucky_fountain.desc: Places 3 new lucky blocks within 2 blocks (x/z) of the broken one, at its height, only into empty space, each with random luck 40-80. Chain effect: not drawn from a block already 2 deep in a chain.
outcome.rngambling.ancient_debris.desc: Drops 4 ancient debris (smelt into 4 netherite scrap).
outcome.rngambling.warhorse.desc: Spawns a horse within 3 blocks, tamed to you, saddled and wearing diamond horse armour, with 30 max health (15 hearts), movement speed 0.335 and jump strength 0.95 (both near vanilla's best).
outcome.rngambling.enchanted_bow.desc: Drops a bow with Power VI (past vanilla's V), Punch II, Infinity and Flame. No arrows (Infinity needs one in your inventory).
outcome.rngambling.hero_of_the_village.d: Gives you Hero of the Village V for 60 seconds (big villager discounts while it lasts).
outcome.rngambling.mob_repellent.desc: For 10 minutes, hostile mobs can't spawn naturally within 32 blocks of you (mobs already around, spawners and other spawn kinds are unaffected). No effect icon or message; a server restart ends it early.
outcome.rngambling.ocean_heart.desc: Drops 1 Heart of the Sea and 8 nautilus shells (exactly enough for a conduit).
outcome.rngambling.token_jackpot.desc: Drops 2-4 Piles of Tokens (9 Casino Tokens each when crafted) and 4-8 Casino Tokens (22-44 tokens' worth), with the challenge-complete fanfare and 2 fireworks.
outcome.rngambling.villager_friends.desc: Spawns two master-level (5), never-despawning villagers within 2 blocks, with fixed trades (12 uses each). Librarian: 8 emeralds + book for Mending; 6 + book for Unbreaking III; 6 + book for Efficiency V; 8 + book for Protection IV; 2 emeralds for 8 bottles o' enchanting. Toolsmith: 4 emeralds for a diamond; 12 for a diamond pickaxe Efficiency IV Unbreaking III; 12 for a diamond axe Efficiency IV Unbreaking III; 16 for a diamond chestplate Protection III Unbreaking III; 3 for 8 golden carrots.
outcome.rngambling.netherite_armor_set.d: Drops a netherite helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots, each with Protection VI and Unbreaking V (both past vanilla's IV and III).
outcome.rngambling.god_sword.desc: Drops a netherite sword with Sharpness VII, Looting IV, Fire Aspect III (all past vanilla's V, III, II) and Mending.
outcome.rngambling.elytra_rockets.desc: Drops an elytra with Unbreaking V (past vanilla's III) and 64 plain firework rockets.
outcome.rngambling.complete_beacon.desc: Drops 1 beacon and 164 iron blocks (2 stacks + 36), exactly a full 4-level pyramid.
outcome.rngambling.treasure_island.desc: Puts you on a round sand island in the Sandbox (about 29 blocks across, with a lagoon ring of water and a sand rim) with 3 jungle-log palm trees and 4 chests: 2 buried treasure, 1 shipwreck treasure, 1 end city treasure. A 'Time left' boss bar runs 3 minutes. Every block can be broken (sand, logs, leaves, chests) but nothing can be placed. There's no exit portal: you're sent back when the 3 minutes are up, with your inventory and any items lying around.
outcome.rngambling.boss_bounty.desc: Chat offers 'A Boss Bounty: fight an Illager Warlord for a massive reward, or take a smaller one now?' with clickable [Accept] / [Decline]. Decline, or no answer in 60 seconds: 'The bounty goes unclaimed. A smaller reward, then:' and a random Good-tier effect plays at your feet in the world. Accept: a 25x25 dark-oak arena (open roof) in the Sandbox with an Evoker named 'Illager Warlord' riding a Ravager plus 3 Vindicators. When no hostile mob (vexes included) is left within 14 blocks: 'Bounty claimed!', 2 netherite ingots, and two Legendary-tier effects rolled at luck 100 in the arena; you're brought back 15 seconds later with the loot. 5-minute limit.
outcome.rngambling.heart_container.desc: Permanently adds 1 heart (2 max health) to you via an attribute modifier, stacking with earlier Heart Containers up to the config max_bonus_hearts (default 10 hearts = +20 health); at the cap it adds nothing. Heals you 1 heart.
outcome.rngambling.lucky_pinata.desc: Places 10 new lucky blocks within 3 blocks (x/z) and 0-1 up from the broken one, only into empty space (some may be skipped), each with random luck 60-100, and launches 3 fireworks. Chain effect: not drawn from a block already 2 deep in a chain.
outcome.rngambling.golden_feast.desc: Gives you Saturation I and Regeneration I for 10:00 each (hunger stays topped up the whole time). No food items.
outcome.rngambling.enchanters_study.desc: Drops 1 enchanting table, 15 bookshelves and 64 lapis lazuli.
outcome.rngambling.perfect_pickaxe.desc: Drops a netherite pickaxe with Efficiency VII, Fortune IV, Unbreaking V (all past vanilla limits) and Mending.
outcome.rngambling.diamond_pillar.desc: Takes you to the Sandbox; a diamond-block pillar rises 3 blocks east of you, one block every 6 ticks to 6 high, then at 4.5 seconds it breaks apart, dropping 6 diamond blocks. You're brought back (after at least 6 seconds, once things settle) and the 6 diamond blocks come with you to where you broke the block.
outcome.rngambling.shulker_stash.desc: Drops 5 empty shulker boxes, each a random colour from red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, cyan and pink (repeats possible).
outcome.rngambling.genies_wish.desc: Opens a one-row chest window, 'Genie's Wish: choose one', showing 3 different picks from 12: netherite sword (Sharpness VII, Looting IV, Mending); netherite pickaxe (Efficiency VII, Fortune IV, Mending); elytra (Unbreaking V, Mending); trident (Loyalty III, Impaling VII, Mending); mace (Density VII, Wind Burst II); a nether star; 3 enchanted golden apples; 2 totems of undying; 4 netherite ingots; a beacon; 8 diamond blocks; 2 Blessed Lucky Blocks. Clicking one puts it in your inventory; closing without choosing gives one of the three at random. Chat: 'Your wish is granted: <item>'.
outcome.rngambling.phoenix_blessing.desc: Marks you (saved with your player, so it survives logging out) to cheat death once: chat 'Phoenix Blessing: you will rise once from death.' On your next death (a held totem goes first) the death is cancelled: half your max health back, fire put out, ALL effects removed, then Fire Resistance 40 s and Regeneration II 10 s; hostile mobs within 6 blocks are set on fire for 8 s and knocked back. Chat: 'The Phoenix rises! Your blessing is spent.' Getting it twice doesn't stack.
outcome.rngambling.dragon_hatchling.desc: Spawns a Dragon Hatchling within 2 blocks, tamed to you and never despawning. It behaves like a tame wolf (follows, sits when told, defends you, heals on meat) but has 50 health, 6 attack damage, 4 armour, speed 0.32, is immune to fire, and its bite sets the target alight for 3 s; it can't breed or fly. Chat: 'A Dragon Hatchling! It's yours: it follows you and fights for you, and sits when told.'
outcome.rngambling.mystery_treasure.desc: Drops 3 Mystery Item draws: each a random item from everything craftable or found in the world (any mod, minus #rngambling:lucky_blacklist), stackables as 4-16.
outcome.rngambling.scaled_loot_chest.des: Drops one roll of a vanilla chest loot table chosen by luck: below 10 dungeon, 10-39 abandoned mineshaft, 40-69 desert pyramid, 70+ end city treasure. Loot luck = luck / 25 (0 when negative).
outcome.rngambling.mystery_box_mob.desc: Negative luck: 1 + round(2 x |luck|/100) hostiles of one random type (zombie, skeleton, spider, creeper or witch) within 3 blocks: 1 at luck -1 to -24, 2 at -25 to -60. Luck 0 or more: one pet (wolf, cat or parrot) within 2 blocks, tamed to you.
outcome.rngambling.scaled_explosion.desc: An explosion at the block's spot in the real world (breaks blocks like TNT, no fire): power 2 at luck -20 rising evenly to 6 at -100 (TNT is 4), capped by the config max_explosion_power (default 6).
outcome.rngambling.double_or_nothing.des: Chat: 'Double or Nothing? Roll again at twice this block's luck, or walk away with a few tokens:' with clickable [Double] / [Walk away]. Double: 'Doubled! Rolling again...' and a new random effect (never Double or Nothing again) at your feet at luck x2, capped at +/-100, so good luck gets better and bad worse. Walk away, or no answer in 60 seconds: 2-4 Casino Tokens go into your inventory ('You walked away with N Casino Tokens.').
outcome.rngambling.piglin_brute_squad.de: Three Piglin Brutes, who never zombify, come for the player. In a ring 6 blocks out.
outcome.rngambling.shulker_barrage.desc: Four shulkers surround the player; their bullets lift you up, and the ground is a long way down. In a ring 5 blocks out, all targeting the player.
outcome.rngambling.illager_ambush.desc: Three vindicators and a pillager, all after the player. Vindicators 7 blocks out, the pillager 9.
outcome.rngambling.blaze_visit.desc: Three blazes appear around the player, even in the Overworld. In a ring 6 blocks out, 2 blocks up.
outcome.rngambling.breeze_storm.desc: Two breezes, and their wind charges, bounce the player about. In a ring 6 blocks out.
outcome.rngambling.lost_armor.desc: One worn armor piece flies off in a random direction (it can be picked up again). No armor: Weakness II for a minute.
outcome.rngambling.hiccups.desc: Every few seconds for 30 seconds the player hiccups: a little hop and a burp. 12 hiccups, one every 2.5 seconds (30 seconds in all); each is a small upward push.
outcome.rngambling.leaky_pockets.desc: For a minute, every 5 seconds a stack falls out of the backpack (not the hotbar) at the player's feet. 12 checks, one every 5 seconds; the stacks are dropped, not deleted.
outcome.rngambling.stage_fright.desc: Darkness for 15 seconds, with a heartbeat thumping in the player's ears. The heartbeat sounds 12 times, every 1.25 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.pillager_patrol.desc: Three pillagers with crossbows, after the player. In a ring 9 blocks out.
outcome.rngambling.bogged_ambush.desc: Three bogged skeletons with poison arrows. In a ring 8 blocks out.
outcome.rngambling.hotbar_shuffle.desc: The hotbar's nine slots are shuffled.
outcome.rngambling.puffer_surprise.desc: Three pufferfish flop about at the player's feet; they puff up and poison when close. Within 1 block of the lucky block.
outcome.rngambling.up_up_and_away.desc: Levitation II for 3 seconds, then the fall.
outcome.rngambling.spoiled_food.desc: One stack of food turns into as much rotten flesh. No food: Hunger II for 30 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.fish_rain.desc: Eight cod, salmon and tropical fish fall from the sky around the player. Dropped 10-14 blocks up, within 4 blocks.
outcome.rngambling.topsy_turvy.desc: Up to eight nearby animals are named Dinnerbone and turn upside down. None about: two upside-down pigs. Within 12 blocks; tamed pets and named animals are left alone. Naming them also stops them despawning.
outcome.rngambling.statue_of_you.desc: An armor stand wearing the player's own head, with a name tag. Its name tag reads "<your name>, Legend".
outcome.rngambling.spotlight.desc: The player glows (visible through walls) for two minutes. Glowing I for 120 seconds.
outcome.rngambling.haunted.desc: For 20 seconds, doors creak, chests open and something shuffles about nearby. Nothing is there. 10 sounds, one every 2 seconds, from random spots within 6 blocks.
outcome.rngambling.about_face.desc: The player is spun round to face the other way. Your yaw turns 180 degrees; nothing else changes.
outcome.rngambling.moon_gravity.desc: Jump Boost III and Slow Falling for a minute.
outcome.rngambling.frog_chorus.desc: Four frogs. Within 2 blocks of the lucky block; their colour follows the biome.
outcome.rngambling.redstone_kit.desc: 32 redstone, 4 repeaters, 2 comparators, 4 pistons, 2 sticky pistons, 2 observers.
outcome.rngambling.night_owl.desc: Night Vision for 10 minutes and 32 torches.
outcome.rngambling.tamers_pack.desc: 2 name tags, 4 leads, a saddle and 8 bones.
outcome.rngambling.divers_kit.desc: A turtle shell, two long Water Breathing potions and a long Night Vision potion.
outcome.rngambling.travelers_kit.desc: A compass, an empty map, a clock, a boat, a bed and 16 steaks.
outcome.rngambling.beekeeper.desc: A beehive, a campfire, 4 honey bottles, 6 honeycomb and two bees to move in. The bees are ordinary (not angry).
outcome.rngambling.trim_collector.desc: Two random armor trim templates (any mod's too).
outcome.rngambling.netherite_upgrade_kit: A netherite upgrade template and a netherite ingot.
outcome.rngambling.diamond_tool_set.desc: Diamond pickaxe, axe and shovel, each with Efficiency III and Unbreaking III.
outcome.rngambling.elixir_stash.desc: Six potions: Strength II, Regeneration II, Swiftness II, and long Fire Resistance, Invisibility and Night Vision.
outcome.rngambling.trident_of_storms.des: Trident with Loyalty III, Channeling, Impaling VII, Unbreaking V and Mending (past vanilla's limits).
outcome.rngambling.heavenly_mace.desc: Mace with Density VII, Wind Burst III, Unbreaking V and Mending (past vanilla's limits), and 16 wind charges.
outcome.rngambling.blaze_horde.desc: Replaces Zombie Horde in the Nether: 2-4 blazes in a ring 5 blocks out (more the further luck is from 0).
outcome.rngambling.magma_cube_pack.desc: Replaces Cave Spider Pack in the Nether: 4 magma cubes in a ring 4 blocks out.
Replaces Witch Coven in the Nether: 3 wither skeletons in a ring 5 blocks out.
outcome.rngambling.gold_block_haul.desc: Replaces Iron Haul in the Nether: 2-4 gold blocks.
outcome.rngambling.nether_feast.desc: Replaces Food Basket in the Nether: 12-24 cooked porkchops.
Nether only: 16-32 quartz and 16-32 glowstone dust.
outcome.rngambling.endermite_horde.desc: Replaces Zombie Horde in the End: 8 endermites in a ring 4 blocks out.
outcome.rngambling.shulker_ambush.desc: Replaces Fused Creeper in the End: 2 shulkers within 3 blocks of the lucky block.
outcome.rngambling.levitation_lift.desc: Replaces Orbital Launch in the End: Levitation III for 12 seconds (then the fall).
outcome.rngambling.chorus_feast.desc: Replaces Food Basket in the End: 12-24 chorus fruit.
outcome.rngambling.void_gaze.desc: Replaces Single Lightning Bolt in the End: Blindness I and Slowness II, 10 seconds each.
outcome.rngambling.dragons_breath.desc: End only: 3-6 bottles of dragon's breath.
outcome.rngambling.shriek.desc: Replaces Zombie Horde in an Ancient City: Darkness I for 15 seconds and a sculk shrieker's shriek at the lucky block (a sound only; it doesn't raise the Warden warning level).
outcome.rngambling.mooshrooms.desc: Replaces Barnyard in the Mushroom Fields: 3 mooshrooms within 3 blocks of the lucky block.
outcome.rngambling.mushroom_feast.desc: Replaces Food Basket in the Mushroom Fields: 3-5 mushroom stews.
outcome.rngambling.black_cat.desc: Bad Luck II for 5 minutes: -20 on the luck of every lucky block you break, and the casino well against you (every game pays back about 75% of what you bet). A black cat appears within 3 blocks of the lucky block, with a hiss.
outcome.rngambling.broken_mirror.desc: Bad Luck I for 5 minutes: -10 on the luck of every lucky block you break, and the casino a little against you (every game pays back about 90% of what you bet). Glass-break sound.
outcome.rngambling.lucky_streak.desc: Luck I for 5 minutes: +10 on the luck of every lucky block you break, and an edge at the casino (every game pays back about 110% of what you bet).
outcome.rngambling.fortunes_favor.desc: Luck II for 5 minutes: +20 on the luck of every lucky block you break, and a good edge at the casino (every game pays back about 125% of what you bet).
screen.rngambling.journal.title: Lucky Journal
screen.rngambling.journal.help: Every lucky block effect is in here. The ones that have happened to you are written in; the rest are “???” until they do. Pick a tier on the left, then an effect, to read what it does. Scroll this page with the mouse wheel.
message.rngambling.journal.new: New in your Lucky Journal (%s of %s). Craft one from a book and a Casino Token to read it.
message.rngambling.broadcast.catastrophi: %s pulled a Catastrophe: %s. Thoughts and prayers.
commands.rngambling.journal.reveal: Every effect is now in %s's Lucky Journal
outcome.rngambling.fortune_teller.quip: Cross my palm with silver. Or don't, it's free.
outcome.rngambling.fortune_teller.desc: Draws a tier now, by the same odds a lucky block at this luck would have, and tells you: your next lucky block will be that tier, guaranteed (any effect within it). Chat: 'Fortune Teller: the cards say your next lucky block will be <tier>.' A newer fortune or jinx replaces an older one. Enchanting sound.
outcome.rngambling.jinxed.quip: Somebody up there doesn't like you.
outcome.rngambling.jinxed.desc: Your next lucky block will be Bad (7 times in 10) or Very Bad (3 in 10), guaranteed, whatever its luck. Chat: 'You've been jinxed: your next lucky block will be <tier>.' An Insurance Policy still covers it. A newer fortune or jinx replaces an older one.
outcome.rngambling.insurance_policy.quip: Read the fine print. Actually, there isn't any.
outcome.rngambling.insurance_policy.desc: The next bad effect a lucky block draws for you (Bad, Very Bad or Catastrophic) never happens. Chat when it pays out: 'Insurance paid out: <effect> never happened.' One policy at a time; it lasts until it's used, through death.
outcome.rngambling.reroll_ticket.quip: Don't like your luck? Try again.
outcome.rngambling.reroll_ticket.desc: A Re-roll Ticket. Hold it in your off hand when you break a lucky block: it's used up, and the block draws two effects and shows both in a window, 'Re-roll Ticket: choose one'. Click the one you want; closing the window without choosing plays one of the two at random.
outcome.rngambling.reroll_ticket.title: Re-roll Ticket: choose one
outcome.rngambling.pet_rock.desc: A Pet Rock with a name, a like and a dislike, chosen at random. It does nothing. Use it to pet it.
message.rngambling.fate.fortune: Fortune Teller: the cards say your next lucky block will be %s.
message.rngambling.fate.jinxed: You've been jinxed: your next lucky block will be %s.
message.rngambling.fate.insured: Insurance Policy: your next bad lucky block is covered.
message.rngambling.fate.still_insured: Insurance Policy: you're already covered. One policy at a time.
command.rngambling.effect.offered: %s held a Re-roll Ticket: offered a choice of two
tooltip.rngambling.reroll_ticket: Hold in your off hand while breaking a lucky block: choose between two effects. One use.
